parameters.command:
=cd /home/node
rm -rf {{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.repositorio }}
git clone https://{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.username }}:{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.token }}@github.com/{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.username }}/{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.repositorio }}.git
cd {{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.repositorio }}
git config user.name "{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.nome }}"
git config user.email "{{ $('Edit Fields - Variaveis').item.json.email }}"
echo OK

=sh << 'SHELLEOF'
set -e
export TZ='America/Sao_Paulo'
NOW=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
BACKUP_DIR="/home/node/{{ $json.repositorio }}"
DATA_TABLES_DIR="$BACKUP_DIR/data-tables"
mkdir -p "$DATA_TABLES_DIR"
cd "$BACKUP_DIR"
cat > "$DATA_TABLES_DIR/{{ $json.safeName }}.json" << 'JSONEOF'
{{ $json.jsonContent }}
JSONEOF
cat > "$DATA_TABLES_DIR/{{ $json.safeName }}.csv" << 'CSVEOF'
{{ $json.csvContent }}
CSVEOF
git add "$DATA_TABLES_DIR/{{ $json.safeName }}.json" "$DATA_TABLES_DIR/{{ $json.safeName }}.csv"
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "$NOW - [DATA TABLE] {{ $json.tableName }} ({{ $json.totalRows }} registros)"
  echo "COMMITTED: {{ $json.tableName }}"
else
  echo "UNCHANGED: {{ $json.tableName }}"
fi
SHELLEOF

=sh << 'SHELLEOF'
set -e
export TZ='America/Sao_Paulo'
NOW=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
TAG_NAME="backup-datatables-$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')"
REPO={{ $json[0].repositorio }}
BACKUP_DIR="/home/node/$REPO"
cd "$BACKUP_DIR"
LOCAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
REMOTE=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo 'none')
if [ "$LOCAL" != "$REMOTE" ]; then
  TOTAL=$(find "$BACKUP_DIR/data-tables" -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  git tag -a "$TAG_NAME" -m "Backup Data Tables - $NOW - $TOTAL tabelas"
  git push origin main
  git push --tags
  echo "[$NOW] Push concluido. $TOTAL tabelas. Tag: $TAG_NAME"
else
  echo "[$NOW] Nenhuma alteracao. Push ignorado."
fi
rm -rf "$BACKUP_DIR"
SHELLEOF
